rows.text: This time, you are mentally prepared for it. When you see the cuckoo clock fanatic with curly chestnut hair walking in your direction, you are convinced that nothing will make him give up. However, you are ready to face him!
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Oh, my old friend! It's been a long time! I've just bid farewell with all the inorganic beings in the Black Forest." The cuckoo clock fanatic starts sobbing when he sees you. "I've contacted the Business Development Department of the IPC, and they've promised to help us promote our fan club in the universe! We'll be a stronger team soon!"
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: There are a lot of newly excavated cuckoo clocks behind him...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Trade your most cherished cuckoo clock with him.
Obtain 1 random cuckoo clock series Negative Curio and a 3-star Blessing.
Give all cuckoo clocks to your opponent in exchange for the same number of Curios.
Give all cuckoo clocks to your opponent in exchange for the same number of Blessings.
